## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Savi?

Savi is the only app built to protect your whole family from spam and scams — across calls and texts, 24/7.

We combine smart voicemail, text protection, On-Call scam detection, and Scamwise — our free scam checker — into one app that goes beyond your phone's built-in protection.

Whether you're protecting your own inbox or looking out for an aging parent, Savi helps keep everyone safe by blocking and flagging scams before they can cause harm. Plus, we'll automatically clean up all your junk messages, too.

What does Savi do?

Savi protects you from scams across calls, texts, and voicemail. It has four core features:

- **Savi Voicemail** — Savi acts as your smarter, safer voicemail. When an unknown caller comes in, Savi takes a message, identifies who's real, and filters spam and scam attempts so you only see what's worth your attention.
- **Text Protection** — Automatically filters scam and spam texts to junk before you ever see them (iPhone only).
- **Savi On-Call** — Add Savi silently to any live call for a real-time read on whether something is a scam.
- **Scamwise** — Submit any suspicious message, image, or situation and get a clear verdict instantly. Free to use even without a subscription.

What is Scamwise?

Scamwise is Savi's free scam-checking tool. Paste in any website, message, or phone number and get an answer instantly.

**On the web:** Visit [scamwise.com](http://scamwise.com/) — no account needed.

**In the app:** Create a free account and use Scamwise directly in the Savi app. Available on iOS and Android.

Scamwise is always free. No trial, no credit card required.

What devices does Savi work on?

**iPhone (iOS):** Full protection — Savi Voicemail, Text Protection (SMS and iMessage), Savi On-Call, and Scamwise.

**Android:** Savi Voicemail, Savi On-Call, and Scamwise. Text Protection is not available on Android due to platform-level restrictions on third-party SMS filtering.

**Scamwise:** Visit [scamwise.com](http://scamwise.com/) to use Scamwise in any browser on desktop, mobile, or tablet. To use Scamwise as an app, you can download the Savi app on iPhone or Android.

The Savi app is not available on tablet or desktop at this time.

Does Savi work with my carrier?

Savi works with most major US carriers, including AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, and more. If your carrier supports conditional call forwarding — and most do — Savi will work.

During setup, the app detects your carrier automatically and walks you through activation. Some prepaid or smaller carriers may not support call forwarding. If that's the case, the app will let you know, and Scamwise will still work without any carrier dependency.

Not sure about your carrier? Contact us ( [support@savisecurity.com](mailto:support@savisecurity.com)) and we'll check for you.

Is Savi available outside the US?

Savi is currently available in the United States only. We're focused on getting the US experience right before expanding. If you're interested in international availability, let us know — it helps us prioritize what's next.

Can I use Savi as an individual or is it only for families?

Savi works great for individuals as well as families. One subscription protects your phone with Savi Voicemail, Text Protection, Savi On-Call, and Scamwise — no family members required.

If you decide to add family members later, they're covered under the same subscription at no extra cost.
